reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her DM: she should keep Tuesday, Nov 10 at 12:45 free for the Lantern call.

The time comes from her own note to me in that DM on Oct 14. She said her standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Lantern rollout is every Tuesday at 12:45. Her calendar has nothing booked for Nov 9–13, so I also told her nothing will hold that slot for her automatically. I didn't add anything to her calendar, because she said at the time that she didn't want any action taken.
